title: Evolve CIMA Artist Wilderness mainland frameset listing
notes: Official mainland product page for CIMA Artist – Wilderness lists CNY 14,800 and exposes selectable frame sizes with an add-to-cart control. It states the package includes CIMA frame, fork, seatpost and essential parts; the Kreuza integrated handlebar is an optional add-on. Its core specifications match the Evolve CIMA road candidate (650 g M unpainted, T1100/T800/M40, BSA 68 mm, 24–32C), while the named finish differs from the global CIMA Speed Navy White listing. Shipping, final checkout amount and selected-size stock were not established.
